changeSet.author: arena
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_attendance_credential ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, academy_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.customer(id), student_id BIGINT NOT NULL, kind VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('QR','NFC')), token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE, active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, revoked_at TIMESTAMP, created_by VARCHAR(100), FOREIGN KEY(student_id,academy_id) REFERENCES ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_student(id,academy_id) ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX academy_attendance_credential_active ON ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_attendance_credential(academy_id,student_id,kind) WHERE active=true; CREATE TABLE ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_attendance ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, academy_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.customer(id), session_id BIGINT NOT NULL, enrollment_id BIGINT NOT NULL, student_id BIGINT NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('PROVISIONAL','PRESENT','ABSENT','LATE')), capture_method VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL CHECK(capture_method IN ('QR','NFC','MANUAL')), captured_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, confirmed_at TIMESTAMP, captured_by VARCHAR(100), confirmed_by VARCHAR(100), note VARCHAR(500), UNIQUE(session_id,enrollment_id), FOREIGN KEY(session_id,academy_id) REFERENCES ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.training_session(id,academy_id), FOREIGN KEY(enrollment_id,academy_id) REFERENCES ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_enrollment(id,academy_id), FOREIGN KEY(student_id,academy_id) REFERENCES ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_student(id,academy_id) ); CREATE INDEX academy_attendance_session ON ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_attendance(academy_id,session_id,status); CREATE INDEX academy_attendance_student ON ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_attendance(academy_id,student_id,captured_at);
